guard: FrameReader refuses a client-claimed length above MAX_FRAME_SIZE at the header, drains complete frames before bounding residual, and still round-trips a max-size frame coalesced with a small one
why: An unauthenticated local peer can send a 4-byte header claiming hundreds of megabytes. The per-frame cap refuses that at the header, before any body. Bounding accumulation BEFORE drain also refuses a legitimate max-size frame coalesced with the next frame on the same read. The coalesced cell is the control for that second defect; both cells import src through tsx and the live custodian loads dist, so afterRestore rebuilds.

mutations.name: M1 drop the per-frame size rejection
mutations.expectRed: a claimed 500MB frame is refused before the body arrives
mutations.cell: a claimed 500MB frame is refused before the body arrives
